posts.title: Kaomoji.moe now runs on Cloudflare Workers
posts.description: I haven't worked on https://kaomoji.moe in 5 years... that's a long time. It used to cost me $0.02/mo to run on Google Cloud Run, mostly because there's been basically zero growth in the last couple years. I think that's mainly due to the cold-boot problem Cloud Run has. posts.title: The language we use to talk about things shapes how we feel about them
posts.description: This is a bit of a follow up post on my previous one about "vibe coding" and what I'm doing with it. It's been a bit of a whirlwind since then as I've gone deeper down the rabbit hole of what's actually possible with LLMs and agentic engineering and my opinions are changing, again. Not feeling the vibe In between discussions with my colleagues about how they're managing with the advent of LLMs/AI
